name: Tissue multi-marker nuclear segmentation reference
selection: Selected on S-BIAD634 Ganglioneuroblastoma fields 0,1,6 from four model/diameter/normalization configurations and two area cutoffs; frozen before scoring fields 2,3,4,7,8,9,10. No weight training.
scope: Development reference for DAPI-like tissue nuclei. Ten fields originate from one cryosection; field-held-out, not patient-held-out. Pretraining overlap unknown. Adapt diameter to acquisition scale; review crowded and weak nuclei. Marker measurements stay in raw units.
